label.en: Communicate or pre-empt (homicidal empires get a pre-empt-only option)

note.zh: 选项a同时启用项目1与2；选项b仅限嗜杀文明，只启用项目2。
note.en: Option a enables projects 1 and 2; option b (homicidal empires only) enables project 2 alone.

label.zh: 先发制人失败：60%入侵 / 40%地底人现身

note.zh: SEISMIC_DISTURBANCE_2 失败时的 random_list（地底人现身权重经修正）。
note.en: random_list on failure of SEISMIC_DISTURBANCE_2 (the aliens-surface weight is modified).

label.zh: 战争池（胜利后）

note.zh: 每个事件至多一次，平均240个月，彼此独立。60再次引发入侵；61塌陷（需有军队）、62袭扰、63地表进攻。
note.en: Each at most once, mean 240 months, independent. 60 triggers another invasion; 61 collapse (needs an army), 62 raids, 63 surface attack.

label.zh: 摧毁池

note.zh: 每个事件至多一次，平均240个月：64幸存者据点、65地底扩张、66黄金、67宝库、68地震。
note.en: Each at most once, mean 240 months: 64 survivor pocket, 65 expansion, 66 gold, 67 treasury, 68 earthquakes.

label.zh: 友好池

note.zh: 每个事件至多一次，平均240个月：69饥荒、70礼物、71难民、72人类学家、73地震、74技术请求。
note.en: Each at most once, mean 240 months: 69 famine, 70 gift, 71 refugees, 72 anthropologists, 73 earthquakes, 74 technology request.

label.zh: 地底帝国取得星球
label.en: A subterranean empire holds the planet

note.zh: 殖民地被地底国家占领，故事结束。
note.en: The colony is lost to a subterranean country; the story ends.

notes.zh: 殖民地2或3岁时的随机事件（权重3/958、2/739）；非AI、非机械/荒野帝国，排除多种特殊星球；全局仅一次。
notes.en: Random colony event at age 2 or 3 (weights 3/958, 2/739); non-AI, non-machine/wilderness empire, many special planet classes excluded; once per game.

notes.zh: 75：关系恶化（怒气>2）后20天内移除友好标记并发信，76 随后在35+40天后引发入侵54。
notes.en: 75: once anger exceeds 2 the friendly flag is removed and a message sent (76), then invasion 54 follows after 35 days + random 40.

scope.zh: 地底文明完整故事：地震异象、三个项目、入侵与胜败、胜利后/摧毁后/友好后的三组每月随机事件、地底人怒气升级。
scope.en: Whole Subterranean Civilization story: seismic disturbances, the three projects, invasion and its victory/defeat, the three monthly random pools (war / destroyed / friendly), and the escalation through angry subterraneans.

uncertain: colony.51 sets the friendly flag unconditionally at contact, even if 53 then picks the war option; the script does not stop friendly-pool events firing in that case.
